connector.name: OrcaRouter
connector.registryDescription: Browse 160+ LLM models and live pricing - no API key needed for catalog. Add key to route chat.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the continuum-ai-corp account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ORCAROUTER_API_KEY
env.description: OrcaRouter API key. Required only for orcarouter_chat. Catalog tools (orcarouter_models_list, orcarouter_model_card, orcarouter_providers_list) work without it.

env.name: ORCAROUTER_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the gateway base URL. Defaults to https://api.orcarouter.ai.

env.name: ORCAROUTER_REQUEST_TIMEOUT
env.description: Per-request timeout in seconds. Defaults to 300 (5 minutes) to accommodate long reasoning-model completions.
